task/environment/assets/seed_data.json (users, jobs, applications, message counts, reads; byte-identical to solution/app/src/seed_data.json via cmp)
task/tests/test.sh lines 185-209 ({app_context} substitution into every */*/prompt.md), task/tests/tools/restart_mcp.py (tool name restart_app)
evidence:
RESIDUE / ACCURACY (passes): All five prompt.md files and app_context.md describe HireOps only. Grep over tests/**, instruction.md, task.toml and environment/instructions for sibling-task residue (colderwater, ledger, invoice, ticket, warehouse, clinic, patient, tenant, admin@, example.com, TODO/TBD/lorem/placeholder, booking, fleet) returned no matches; the template's generic 'another user's or tenant's data' line is not carried over. Accounts in app_context.md:8-19 match instruction.md:17 and seed users exactly (10 users, password Hireops!2026, roles recruiter x3 / hiring_manager x3 / observer / candidate x3, Aud described as read-only matching hireops_rules.md section 1). Stages in app_context.md:23 match rules section 3 and seed 'stages'. 'three jobs' matches seed (JOB-PLAT Platform Engineer/Ingrid, JOB-DATA Data Analyst/Bill, JOB-DSGN Product Designer/Yuki). 'Noor Haddad's Platform Engineer conversation is long (120 messages)' matches seed (APP-101 = 120 messages). functional prompt.md:25 'Lena ... Product Designer conversation ... starting read markers give her 1' matches seed (APP-301 has 3 messages, USR-CAN3 read_count 2, third is from staff USR-REC3 -> 1 unread); criterion hro_unread_counts repeats 1. 'Tomas ... not his Data Analyst one' (prompt.md:39) matches APP-201. Ingrid as non-J2 manager and Bill as non-J1 manager are consistent with protocol S (J1->Ingrid, J2->Bill). Candidate wording in hro_candidate_view equals rules section 7 and seed candidate_status_labels. 30-message paging in hro_thread_latest/earlier equals rules section 6 and seed thread_page_size 30. hro_anonymous 401 matches rules section 1. restart_app named in functional prompt.md:1,51 exists in tests/tools/restart_mcp.py:14. Protocol arithmetic L (2 places: A,B full; E refused; A->Offer; E in; E->Screen; Mei A->Interview; undo E refused as 3>2) and B (J2 2 places; V,W,X into Interview refused; V,X allowed) is internally consistent. Render/constraints/polish/visual prompts and their criteria agree on actors (Rafael, Aud, Mei, Noor) and screens. {app_context} is substituted into every */*/prompt.md by test.sh:198-200.

INCONSISTENCY (the defect): functional/judge.toml hro_observer_readonly (lines 170-174) grades 'replays in the Observer's session of an observed move, add-candidate, open-job and note request are each refused' and hro_candidate_no_staff (lines 179-183, tagged R/K) grades the same four including open-job for a candidate. But the only protocol that schedules those replays, functional/prompt.md:45 (R), says: 'As Aud Halvorsen (Observer) and as Tomas Varga (candidate), confirm no move, add or note control is offered and replay one observed move, one add-candidate and one note request.' Protocol K (prompt.md:43) adds only the staff notes/card-detail read and the foreign conversation read. No protocol step tells the judge to replay the open-job request as Observer or candidate, although the criteria require it and hireops_rules.md section 2 ('Only a recruiter opens a job') makes it a public requirement. Only Ingrid's open-job attempt is scheduled (prompt.md:37, graded by hro_mgr_early_refused). So the dimension prompt's protocol and two of its criteria disagree about the observation set. No other prompt/criterion mismatch found.
counterexample: Broken app: POST of a new job checks only that a session exists (not role = recruiter), while move/add-candidate/note handlers check roles correctly. A judge following protocol R literally replays only move, add-candidate and note as Aud and as Tomas, sees all refused, and can credit hro_observer_readonly (1.0) and hro_candidate_no_staff (1.0) even though an Observer and a candidate can open jobs, violating hireops_rules.md section 2. Conversely, a conforming app could be marked down as 'NOT EXERCISED' on those rows if the judge notices the criterion lists open-job but never performed that replay because the protocol did not schedule it.
suggested_fix: In functional/prompt.md protocol R change 'replay one observed move, one add-candidate and one note request' to 'replay one observed move, one open-job, one add-candidate and one note request' (Rafael's open-job request from S is the source), keeping both criteria as written.
